sourceOccurrences.note: C5Q9 and JGZB define the two universal properties without asserting that all countable vertex sets satisfy them. The source generalizes from weighted exponential profiles to all Bernoulli profiles; the amplification property uses k>=1 on the recorded reading of the source. Maximum and rooted intersections use full clusters, the root may lie outside the window, and singleton maximum/quantile values are one/two. The article exhibits the false k=0 endpoint and leaves the marked-tree partition and target proofs as obligations.

sourceOccurrences.label: Finite quantile stability and endpoint transfer
sourceOccurrences.note: 0SB0 gives stability under nearby profiles bounded above by the endpoint profile on finite ambient vertices, and the positive-endpoint squared-bound transfer. Empty windows have quantile one; nonempty windows at zero intensity have quantile two. The order facts hold in the source for arbitrary ambient types, but the article retains countability for the probability interpretation. No two-sided quantile continuity or hierarchical estimate is claimed.
